Select compounds with IC50 activities in nM against human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL4282). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL ID CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
